elements.element: Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The Company must pay the Termination Payment upon termination, subject to the stated cap.

elements.element: Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: The added sentence makes the Termination Payment the Company's sole early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount under the Agreement.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The Termination Payment may not exceed the fees payable by the Company under Section 3.1 for the three months preceding the Termination Date.

elements.element: The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that the Termination Payment is the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company under the Agreement.
